title: Transition naturality for the common pullback compositor
statement: The normalized common-stage pullback compositor is natural along an arrow represented at a larger coefficient stage.

source.place: Tag 099N(5), naturality step in the common-stage composition construction.

proof.text: Specialize the existing common-stage compositor naturality theorem to the representative arrow at the enlarged stage.

lean.statement: theorem commonStagePullbackCompComponent_transition (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Z ⟶ X) [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)] [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)] (M : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Y) (L : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω) (hM : M.stage ≤ L) (r : M.toStage hM ⟶ (⟨L, M.toStage hM⟩ : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Y).toStage le_rfl) : (commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω (h ≫ f)).map (ofHom M ⟨L, M.toStage hM⟩ L hM le_rfl r) ≫ (commonStagePullbackCompComponent l Ω h f ⟨L, M.toStage hM⟩).hom = (commonStagePullbackCompComponent l Ω h f M).hom ≫ (commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω h).map ((commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω f).map (ofHom M ⟨L, M.toStage hM⟩ L hM le_rfl r))
